title: Return to port work
summary: Morris returned to freight handling at the port and stayed, and gave up his truck.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: And I told them I was going to work. I wasn't going back with that moon. Not right then. You see when... Excuse me.
You see when you leave a good record behind, you got a good record.

So they told me they gave me credit for that. See, and I went back at the port and I've been there ever since. Of course, we might get bad, but after all, I'm too glad that I had a place to go to at that time.
What do you do down there at the port?

I handle freight and handle automobiles. See, like all them different automobiles come in. Well, I don't have that same job every day, but I may have it one or two days, and then somebody else gets it. You see, you just got to leave every member to make something. And it's not no special place that you, but it's nice of them freight handling, but after all, any kind of freight that is to be handled, my gang or some of the other members is the one to handle it. Any kind of freight. Anything needs to be done. Well, that's the way that is.
You still have your trucking business too with your little truck. No, sir. You don't do that.
I don't do no harm. I'm going to cut my truck up, I believe. I don't do nothing at all anymore.
